subject: moses
season_1_precall: Drawn from Nile, raised in Egyptian palace, ending in rebellion.
season_2_awakening: Burning bush supernatural epiphany after forty silent years.
season_3_activation: Wandering wilderness in constant conflict with Pharaoh and identity.
season_4_anguishing: Mount Nebo identity struggle, blessing tribes while facing pre-call limits.
season_5_acceptance: Sees the Promised Land but accepts he cannot enter.
negative_exemplar_fault: Murder of an Egyptian and believing fearful scouts over God.

subject: david
season_1_precall: Anointed by Samuel while a shepherd boy.
season_2_awakening: Killed Goliath with a sling shot, awakening national destiny.
season_3_activation: Sauls jealousy triggers wilderness flight, eventually becoming King and bringing the Ark.
season_4_anguishing: Absaloms rebellion and family fragmentation fractures.
season_5_acceptance: Charges Solomon with building the temple and sleeps with his ancestors.
negative_exemplar_fault: Abdicating battlefield leadership, resulting in the Bathsheba moral failure.

subject: paul
season_1_precall: Persecuting Christians and witnessing the stoning of Stephen.
season_2_awakening: Blinding bolt of lightning epiphany on the Damascus road.
season_3_activation: Writing letters to churches, jailed many times telling the story of Jesus.
season_4_anguishing: Thorn in the flesh personal suffering and internal identity battles.
season_5_acceptance: Declares he has fought the good fight and finished the race before execution.
negative_exemplar_fault: Early active execution and persecution of the early Church body.

subject: joseph
season_1_precall: Favored son with a coat of many colors, triggering intense brotherly jealousy.
season_2_awakening: Supernatural prophetic dreams of sheaves and stars bowing down.
season_3_activation: Sold into slavery, managing Potiphars house and interpreting dreams in prison.
season_4_anguishing: Confronting his starving brothers in Egypt, wrestling with past wounds.
season_5_acceptance: Saves his entire lineage and declares: What man meant for evil, God used for good.
negative_exemplar_fault: Boastful youthful pride when sharing early visions with his family.

subject: gideon
season_1_precall: Threshing wheat in a hidden winepress to hide from oppressive Midianites.
season_2_awakening: Angel of the Lord calls him a Mighty Man of Valor, offering a fleece sign.
season_3_activation: Reducing his army down to three hundred men and routing the enemy camp.
season_4_anguishing: Struggling to maintain leadership and control after the victory high.
season_5_acceptance: Dies in a good old age, leaving behind an unstable golden ephod monument.
negative_exemplar_fault: Persistent, fearful demands for repeated miraculous signs to confirm truth.

subject: peter
season_1_precall: Ordinary commercial fisherman working the Sea of Galilee loops.
season_2_awakening: The miraculous catch of fish prompts him to drop his nets and follow.
season_3_activation: Preaching at Pentecost, establishing the early church foundations boldly.
season_4_anguishing: The crucifixion trial night where he breaks down in tears.
season_5_acceptance: Accepts his martyrdom path as foretold by Christ on the beach.
negative_exemplar_fault: Denying any association with Christ three separate times under pressure.

subject: john
season_1_precall: Born to middle class family, completed Computer Science PhD at Case Western.
season_3_activation: Serving in prison ministry, launching AI startup company to build products.
active_subgoal: Determine AI startup ROI via New York business meeting.
contained_plan: Amtrak train routing tracking graph minor.
missing_knowledge_gap: Acquaintances at Stanford and UC Berkeley but knows little of business.
